confidence_notes: Low confidence. Restaurant anchors rest on undated cost-of-living aggregator figures that conflict (for example, the Gweru and Kwekwe beer prices). Cocktail and wine are inferred from beer prices, and accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no live listings checked. July is peak tourist season, so rates may run higher. The FX value came from search-result text attributed to the RBA homepage and exchange-rate page; I could not open the RBA table to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city. Restaurant anchors use citycost.org Victoria Falls estimates as the primary reference, with a Victoria Falls lodge set-dinner price (Pamarah Lodge, January 2026 brochure) as an upper bound for mid-range dining. Cocktail is set at about 2.3x beer and wine at about 1.7x beer, a local price-relationship assumption. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a Zimbabwean tourism town priced in USD.
